title: Saját szerverek
subtitle: Install engines and mods separately, then combine them in persistent server instances.

instances.emptyBody: Create an instance, choose its engine and mod, and keep all server data in its own folder.
instances.engineRequired: Install this engine before starting the server.

details.subtitle: This instance owns its configs, files, logs, databases, and other runtime data.

files.cloneHint: Only marked files are copied to a cloned instance.
files.emptyBody: Add configs, PK3 archives, a mod folder, or any other files this server needs.

config.title: Startup config
config.description: The server executes this file when it starts. Add or change any cvar and exec command here.
config.runningHint: Stop the server before saving config changes.
config.otherFilesHint: Edit other CFG, INI, JSON, Lua, and text files from the Files tab.

console.empty: The server has not written any console output yet.

engines.emptyBody: No engine for the selected game provides a dedicated server.
engines.fromGameFiles: Uses the dedicated server from the configured game files.

mods.emptyBody: Add a mod from JKHub or from disk. One installation can be used by several server instances.

create.title: Create server instance
create.body: The instance receives its own writable folder. The engine stays shared, and the selected mod is copied into the instance.
create.publicHint: List this server on the public master server.

clone.title: Clone server instance
clone.body: The clone keeps the launch settings and marked files. Runtime databases, logs, and unmarked files stay with the source instance.

addMod.title: Add server mod
addMod.body: A mod is a reusable component. Choose it independently from the server engine.
addMod.featuredBody: Choose a recommended server mod. JKHub entries install here; website entries open their download page.
addMod.noFeatured: No featured mods for this game.
addMod.manageFeaturedBody: The list is stored in JKNet Online. Only an administrator account can change it.
addMod.searchingCategory: Searching every page in this category…

editor.title: Edit server file
editor.copyHint: Include this file when cloning the instance.

deleteInstance.title: Delete server instance?
deleteInstance.body: {{name}} and all of its configs, databases, logs, and other files will be deleted.

deleteFile.title: Delete server file?
deleteFile.body: {{path}} will be deleted from this instance.

deleteMod.title: Delete server mod?
deleteMod.body: {{name}} will be removed from the reusable mod library. Instances that use it must be changed or deleted first.

feedback.actionFailed: The action could not be completed
